JetCool delivers both custom and off‑the‑shelf single‑phase, direct‑to‑chip 
liquid‑cooling architectures built to match your performance, deployment, and 
sustainability requirements. Our engineering team uses advanced fluid‑routing 
methods, including jet impingement, skived surfaces, and hybrid configurations, to 
deliver best‑in‑class cold plate performance.
By standardizing our architectural frameworks and design methodologies, we 
provide data center operators with reliable, practical solutions that scale easily and 
support warm water operation, sustainability goals, and high‑density environments. 
This structured approach enables faster integration, predictable performance, and 
long‑term flexibility.
As an engineering‑driven organization, we offer customized solutions for unique 
applications as well as a catalog of proven, ready‑to‑deploy products. With more 
than 100 thermal experts, JetCool delivers cooling solutions that align seamlessly 
with your performance requirements, timeline, and volume needs.
DLC Cooling Architecture
Foundational Cooling Architectures for Design
Microconvective liquid cooling uses targeted, perpendicular 
jets to directly cool processor hotspots, achieving high 
convective coefficients. This approach eliminates the need 
for heat spreading or enhanced surfaces, and can remove 
thermal interface materials in direct-to-die or package 
setups, improving heat transfer efficiency.
Microconvective Liquid Cooling®
Microchannel liquid cooling relies on parallel, uniform heat 
spreading via small internal fluid channels. These channels 
maximize cooling surface area and enhance contact 
between the coolant and heated surface.

SmartPlate™ 
System
SmartPlate System is a self‑contained liquid cooling solution that makes the shift 
from air to hybrid cooling effortless. Designed to drop into the existing air‑cooled 
footprint, it replaces stock heat sinks with a plug‑and‑play upgrade that looks and 
operates just like a traditional server—no pipes, no plumbing, no retrofits. 
By eliminating infrastructure changes, SmartPlate System enables data centers to 
unlock more compute in power‑constrained environments, often achieving up to 
15% more performance or meaningful reductions in power consumption.1

Driving Sustainable, High-Performance Data Centers
Sustainable Cooling
Powering a Sustainable Tomorrow
JetCool’s industry-leading direct liquid cooling (DLC) technology redefines efficiency and 
sustainability for modern data centers. With ultra-low thermal resistance, our solutions 
significantly reduce power consumption, enabling PUEs as low as 1.02. This breakthrough 
in efficiency lowers operational costs, and facilities meet carbon reduction goals.
Techno-Economic Study of a 40 MW AI Data Center in Virginia
In a case study with a hyperscaler, JetCool modeled a 40 MW AI data center deployment 
using its SmartPlate™ cold plate technology. Compared to microchannel systems, this 
warm-liquid approach cut annual cooling costs by 47%, dropping from $5.2 million to 
$2.7 million. The savings were achieved without sacrificing cooling performance, while 
eliminating the need for evaporative cooling in most climates.

SmartLid™ cooling modules utilize our patented microconvective cooling 
architecture to deliver coolant directly to the processor die, removing both thermal 
interface materials (TIM). Designed per socket, the solution can route coolant to the 
integrated heat spreader (IHS) or silicon, supporting over 3,500W TDP with heat 
transfer coefficients up to 10X higher than traditional cooling approaches.
